Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent provided the correct answer to the first part of the query (identifying Carlo Rovelli as the author) based on the search results, but then hallucinated the second part of the answer. The search results visible in the viewport and metadata only confirm the author and basic book details; they do not contain information about when Carlo Rovelli started working in France. By stating "The year Carlo Rovelli began working in France is 2010" as a fact derived from the search without actually finding that specific data point, the agent fabricated information.
